description: 2020–2024 ACS 5-year estimates for New Jersey tracts, from acs_variables.json (D-086). Percentages carry approximate margins of error; reliability is the coefficient-of-variation class (High up to 12%, Low over 40%). Medians at a Census limit are the limit ('or more' / 'or less').

source.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year summary file
